title: Lexicon Technicum: OR, AN Universal English Dictionary OF ARTS AND SCIENCES
author: John Harris
words_note: 1,042,614 is the cleaned-text total from the cleanup report. Entries + front-matter text totals 1021977 words; the remaining 20637 words are running heads, table fragments and other lines the parser did not assign to an entry (see the cleanup report, section 3.1).
letters_note: Unlike the earlier editions, this edition really does have J and U sections in volume 1 — 45 entries in J and 64 in U — so j.json and u.json hold genuine section entries, not just J/U-spelled headwords filed under I and V. The site looks an entry up by the first letter of its key; the words.json row carries the book's true section.
corrections_note: 80,223 by the cleanup engine + 3,817 by the sentence context pass + 20 by page-image validation.
unresolved: 15,126 distinct tokens / 18,143 occurrences left unresolved by the engine, reduced by the 3,817 context-pass fixes; 2,387 distinct / 3,119 occurrences ambiguous; see lexicon-technicum-1716-unresolved.md.
citation: The book has no printed page numbers. Cite entries by volume, letter section and headword, never by page.
lost_entries_note: Lost entirely; recorded as lost, not invented. MACROCOSME was already lost in the 1704 edition; TORE or Torus and ABDOMINAL were also lost in the 1723 edition. MACHINA Boyliana (lost in 1704) IS present in this edition as 'MACHINA Boylians'. See the cleanup report, section 3.1.
monsters_note: Table regions and treatise prose the parser could not separate; kept whole as cleaned, not split by guesswork. See the cleanup report, section 3.4.
first_entry_note: The first dictionary entry is 'BACOT the Cap of State' as printed — the initial A of ABACOT is lost in the scan; the 1708 edition has 'ABACOT the Cap of State' as its first headword.
front_matter_note: The front-matter record (title page, dedication, preface; lines 0-1297, 6,694 words) is included as-is from the cleaned text; its text is still partly garbled and is pending a separate repair. It is not counted in words.json.
